description: Canonical AuthError (401) corpus. HTTP 401 surfaces as the SDK's AuthError. Covers missing Bearer, and invalid/expired/revoked/unknown credentials resolved by their prefix-specific resolver. The raw token is never echoed in the body.

cases.name: missing_authorization
cases.trigger: Any partner/customer route with no Authorization header.

cases.name: invalid_partner_credential
cases.message: The partner credential is invalid, revoked, or expired.
cases.trigger: customers.list() with a well-formed prt_ + random suffix.

cases.name: invalid_customer_credential
cases.message: The customer credential is invalid, revoked, or expired.
cases.trigger: A cust_ endpoint called with an expired/revoked cust_ session token (e.g. after revokeSession or after expires_at passes).

cases.name: invalid_capability_credential
cases.message: The capability credential is invalid, revoked, or expired.
cases.trigger: delegate() with a missing/malformed/revoked/expired parent cap_ Bearer.
